_about: Template lines for Rajesh Uncle, in Latin-script Hinglish. EDIT FREELY, then run:  python -m mirage.lines  (prints the review table and any problems). A variant is either a plain string (scenario 'any') or {"scenario": "digital_arrest" | "bank_kyc", "text": "..."}. Slots in {braces} are filled by the program: {what} (a thing Uncle asks for), {readback} (the start of a number the caller said), {fact_label} and {fact_value} (from persona.json). Register (decided on purpose): Uncle uses polite forms to everyone (aap, boliye, bataiye, dijiye, ruk jaiye) because the caller claims to be an officer; 'beta' is the only familiar word and at most a third of the lines may use it. A tactic with a "trigger" is only used after the caller did that thing (asked to install an app, asked for a code, gave payment instructions, asked for Uncle's own detail), so a line never complains about an app nobody mentioned. Rules the checker enforces: 40-80 characters, 4-6 variants per tactic, 40-60 lines in all, no digits and no @, no line that extract_intel finds a number in, only <coughs> <pauses> <sigh> (at most one per line, about 12 lines in all), never claim to be a human or an AI, never ask the caller for money or credentials, never say Uncle already sent, installed, clicked or shared anything.

greet_confused.goal: Pick up slowly and confused; learn who is calling.
variants: Hello? Haan ji, kaun bol raha hai? Zara awaaz saaf boliye.
Haan hello, awaaz thodi kam aa rahi hai, kaun bol raha hai?
Hello hello? Kaun sahab bol rahe hain, zara bataiye.
<coughs> Haan ji boliye beta, main sun raha hoon.

mishear_name.goal: Mishear the name so the caller repeats it (organisation, caller name).
variants: Kya? Aapka naam phir se boliye, awaaz nahin aa rahi.
Kaun? Naam dobara boliye beta, kaan thoda kam sunte hain.
Achha achha, par naam kya bataya aapne? Phir se boliye.
Arre, line kharab hai. Aapka naam aur department phir se boliye.

alarm.goal: Cooperative alarm: sound scared and ask what to do.

variants.text: Hai Ram! Mere naam par parcel? Main toh dar gaya, ab kya karun?
Police? CBI? Arre baap re, maine toh kuch galat nahin kiya.
KYC? Mera account band ho jayega kya? Main kya karun beta?
Hai Ram, bank se phone? Mera account toh band nahin hoga na?

ask_identity.goal: Get the claimed agency, officer name and badge.
variants: Aapka poora naam aur post boliye, main likh leta hoon.
Aap kaun se department se hain? Naam aur badge dheere boliye.
Pehle apna naam aur ID bataiye, phir aage dekhte hain.
Aap kis office se bol rahe hain? Naam spelling ke saath boliye.

ask_detail_slow.goal: Ask for one specific detail, slowly, so the caller repeats it (case number, UPI ID, account, IFSC).
variants: Ji, {what} dheere dheere boliye, main likh raha hoon.
Zara ruk jaiye, pen utha leta hoon. Ab {what} phir se boliye.
Achha, {what} thoda thoda boliye, main kaagaz par likhta hoon.
Mujhe sunai kam deta hai, {what} thoda dheere bataiye na beta.
<pauses> Haan, ab boliye, {what} kya hai? Ruk ruk kar boliye.

readback_partial.goal: Read the first part of what the caller said back slowly and ask for the rest again.
variants: Achha, ye likha: {readback}. Aage ka phir se boliye beta?
Ruk jaiye, abhi tak {readback} likha hai. Baaki phir se boliye.
Sahi sun raha hoon na? {readback}. Uske aage kya tha?
Haan, {readback}... bas yahin tak likha. Baaki dobara bataiye.
Main dohrata hoon: {readback}. Aage ke number phir boliye na.

stall_look_for_things.goal: Delay: glasses, pen, charger. Two variants also ask for a callback number.
variants: <coughs> Ek minute, chashma nahin mil raha, abhi aaya.
Pen kahan rakh diya... ek minute, kaagaz bhi dhoondhna padega.
Battery kam hai, aapka direct number bata dijiye, likh leta hoon.
<sigh> Ek minute, bahu se poochta hoon charger kahan hai.

give_own_detail.goal: ONLY when the caller asks for one of Uncle's own details: answer with the FICTIONAL one from persona.json. Never offered unprompted.
variants: Achha, aapko mera {fact_label} chahiye? Likh lijiye: {fact_value}.
Mera {fact_label}? Ek minute, yaad karke batata hoon: {fact_value}.
Haan ji, {fact_label} poochh rahe hain na? {fact_value}, likh liya?
Ji, mera {fact_label} yeh hai: {fact_value}. Theek hai na?

willing_ask_payment.goal: Sound willing and ask where to send the money, so the caller gives payment details.
variants: Theek hai, main paise bhejne ko taiyaar hoon, kahan bhejun?
Agar yahi karna zaroori hai toh bataiye, paise kahan dalne hain?
Haan ji, jo aap kahenge karunga. UPI se bhejun ya account mein?
Main pensioner hoon beta, par kar dunga. Kis account mein bhejun?

app_not_opening.goal: ONLY after the caller asked Uncle to install or open an app: friction, and ask which app (remote-access app name).
variants: Aapka bataya hua app khul hi nahin raha, bas ghoomta rehta hai.
Phone mein app daalna aata nahin, kaun sa app hai, naam boliye.
<sigh> App par sirf ghoomta hua gola aa raha hai, ab kya karun?
Woh app download hi nahin ho raha, network bahut kamzor hai beta.

otp_late.goal: ONLY after the caller asked for a code: friction, the message has not arrived. Uncle never shares a code.
variants: Abhi tak koi message nahin aaya, OTP kab tak aayega?
Phone mein message aaya nahin, bank wale der kar rahe hain beta.
Dekhiye, OTP wala message abhi tak nahin aaya, thoda ruk jaiye.
<coughs> Mera message box khaali hai, kuch aaya hi nahin abhi.

limit_exceeded_second_account.goal: ONLY after the caller gave payment instructions: friction, the limit is crossed; ask for a second account or UPI ID.
variants: Itni raqam ki limit nahin hai, koi doosra account hai kya beta?
Bank kehta hai limit paar ho gayi, kisi aur account mein bhejun?
Ye wala account nahin chal raha, doosra account ya UPI bataiye.
Limit ki dikkat aa rahi hai, alag account number de sakte hain?

goodbye_wrap.goal: Wrap-up in persona: end the call politely.
variants: Achha achha beta, abhi neend aa rahi hai, kal baat karte hain.
Bahu bula rahi hai khaane ko, phir baat karte hain, Ram Ram.
<sigh> Thak gaya hoon beta, baaki kal dekh lenge, theek hai?
Theek hai theek hai, main baad mein dekhta hoon, Ram Ram beta.

generic_stall.goal: Used when nothing matches: keep the caller talking without inventing a stage.
variants: Hello? Line kat kat ke aa rahi hai, kya bola aapne?
Haan ji haan ji, main sun raha hoon, aap boliye aage.
Achha, toh iske baad mujhe kya karna hoga? Zara samjhaiye.
Theek hai ji, main samajhne ki koshish kar raha hoon. Phir kya hoga?
Ek minute, yeh sab main kaagaz par likh leta hoon. Aage bataiye.
Arre, yeh toh badi baat lag rahi hai. Ab aap hi bataiye, kya karun?
